option_relations.rationale: Sézary Syndrome is a leukemic variant of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, characterized by erythroderma and circulating Sézary cells. While related to CTCL, it is distinct from Mycosis Fungoides.

Mycosis Fungoides is a type of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, and the option explicitly states 'Mycosis Fungoides (cutaneous T-cell lymphoma)', making it equivalent to the provided leaf 'Mycosis Fungoides'.
Adult T-cell Leukemia/Lymphoma is caused by HTLV-1 infection and has distinct clinical and pathological features from Mycosis Fungoides.
Ichthyosiform mycosis fungoides is a rare variant of Mycosis Fungoides, making it a subtype of the leaf 'Mycosis Fungoides'.
